sentences.text: Rupali Ghosh vs Unknown on 15 December, 2023

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak
 32 15.12.2023 Cra 227 of 2011

(Ad)
 Court No.5
 With
 Ia No.:CRAN 1 of 2011 (Old No.: Cran 865 of 2011)
 (Assigned)
 In Re: - A petition of appeal under Section 372 of the Code of
 Criminal Procedure, 1973.

And
 In the matter of: - Rupali Ghosh
 ...Appellant.
 Mr. Apalak Basu
 Ms. Pritha Bhowmik
 ... for the Appellant.
 Mr.Navanil De
 ... for the State.
 Mr. Sujit Gupta
 Ms. Amita Gaur
 ... for the opposite parties.
Appellant seeks to prefer an appeal against the  judgment of acquittal.
The accused persons and the State are represented.
CRAN 1 of 2011 (Old No.:CRAN 865 of 2011) is an  application seeking condonation of delay of 70 days.
Appellant is the de facto complainant.
Victim is a lady.
The accused persons were charged, inter alia, under Sections 498A/304B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
The  accused persons were acquitted.

Appellant is the mother of the victim, the de facto Rupali Ghosh vs Unknown on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84465279/
1  complainant and a lady.
The appellant is being represented  through legal aid.
None of the appearing respondents opposes the prayer for condonation of delay.
In such circumstances, we condone the delay of 70 days.
IA No.:CRAN 1 of 2011 (Old No.:CRAN 865 of 2011) is allowed.
Appeal is admitted.
Issue usual notices.
Call for the trial court records.
Paper books be prepared within eight weeks from the date of receipt of trial court records.

Respondent nos.2 to 7 who are accused persons are directed, under Section 390 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, to be present before the jurisdictional Court on or before January 31, 2024 and execute personal bonds to appear as and when ordered by this Court.

If any of them do not appear before the jurisdictional Court and execute bonds as directed herein, warrant shall be issued by this Court and such accused persons shall be arrested and brought before the jurisdictional Court.
In such event, the jurisdictional Court may commit such persons to prison or grant order of bail or consider granting order of bail on condition that may be deemed fit on requisite application.
Appellant and the State will inform the respondent nos.2 to 7 of this order for compliance.
List the appeal in the monthly list of February, 2024.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
